meta.title: Unsubscribe from offers
meta.description: Stop GnomeVPN emails and messages with discounts and offers.

unsubscribed.title: You have unsubscribed from offers
unsubscribed.body: We will not send you discounts and offers any more. Service notices about your subscription keep arriving as before.
unsubscribed.account: Turn them back on in your account

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have been copied only in part. You can also unsubscribe in your account, under Profile.

failed.title: Could not unsubscribe you
failed.body: The server did not answer. Try again a little later, or unsubscribe in your account under Profile.
